The '''''Prince of Waves''''' was a tourist [[Boat/Legends|liner]] that had been in operation for over a [[Standard century/Legends|century]]<ref name="Rust" /> prior to [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> [[Time/Legends|Sometime]] by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the ''Prince of Waves'' carried passengers on its centennial voyage around the [[Waterworld/Legends|ocean world]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. However, the tourist liner sunk during the journey and came to rest balancing on the edge of an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] trench.<ref name="Rust" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By that year,<ref name="Date" /> an individual associated with one of the two sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to search for the wreck of the ''Prince of Waves''. The companion found the wreck on the edge of the trench and recovered riches left by the liner's crew and passengers.<ref name="Rust" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Prince of Waves'' was mentioned in the Crew Skill Mission "Rust and Riches" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Rust" /> The mission was initially only available to Galactic Republic players,<ref name="TORhead">{{WebCite|url=http://www.torhead.com/crew-mission/7NsyHId/rust-and-riches|text=Rust and Riches|work=torhead.com|archivedate=20150317032634|nolive=1}}</ref> though both this restriction and the information about the mission's outcome are no longer a part of the game.<ref name="Rust" />
